title: Locomotive: a thumbnail opens between the words of a title
note: Featured work is a list of project names in the 110px narrow serif, centred, each row between 1px black rules running the full width. Hover a row and a 165×110 thumbnail opens in the gap between two words (The [image] Drake Hotel): its width transitions from 0 to 165px over 0.45s with cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), pushing the words apart. The image arrives pixelated and sharpens, and the letters shuffle briefly (data-hover-shuffle). Single-word names get the image after the word. Worth reusing: the preview sits inside the line of type instead of floating by the cursor, so the title and the picture read as one.
